  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      Result(VfpTableBuilder b, double[] water, double[] gas, double[] lift, double[][][][][] bhp, List<String> warnings, int capPointCount, int extrapolatedCount, int floorRepairs, int thpRepairs, int rateRepairs, double minCap, double maxCap)
      Creates a result from a finished build.
      Parameters:
      b - builder that holds the configuration
      water - water ratio axis
      gas - gas ratio axis
      lift - artificial lift axis
      bhp - flowing pressures [rate][THP][water][gas][ALQ]
      warnings - diagnostics collected during the build
      capPointCount - coordinates above the rate cap
      extrapolatedCount - coordinates filled by extrapolation
      floorRepairs - points raised to the outlet pressure
      thpRepairs - points changed for THP monotonicity
      rateRepairs - points changed for rate monotonicity
      minCap - smallest rate cap or infinity
      maxCap - largest rate cap or zero

    • interpolate

      public double interpolate(double rate, double thp, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Multilinear interpolation of the table, the way a simulator reads it. Coordinates outside the axes are clamped to the axis ends, so check isInsideAxes(double, double, double, double, double) first.
      Parameters:
      rate - rate in Sm3/day
      thp - outlet pressure in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio
      gasRatio - gas ratio
      alq - artificial lift quantity
      Returns:
      interpolated flowing pressure in bara

    • isInsideAxes

      public boolean isInsideAxes(double rate, double thp, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Checks that a coordinate lies within the axis ranges, i.e. the simulator would not extrapolate.
      Parameters:
      rate - rate in Sm3/day
      thp - outlet pressure in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio
      gasRatio - gas ratio
      alq - artificial lift quantity
      Returns:
      true if every coordinate is inside its axis range
